blocking_findings.claim: Section 6 of the 1960 Ordinance vests SOLE authority to grant licences in the Chief Minister
blocking_findings.correction: Section 6: the DIRECTOR may grant prospecting licences WITH THE APPROVAL OF THE MINISTER (the Minister responsible for natural resources). 'Chief Minister' does not appear. Section 14 (leases): Minister WITH CABINET approval.

blocking_findings.claim: one-person discretion model / single point of failure (Chief Minister)
blocking_findings.correction: Formal issuance is by the Department of Lands and Surveys Sabah; SMM is a technical due-diligence gatekeeper. The 'one office' spine is not supported by the statute.
